evaluate_cloth_model_rollout: run the evaluate function to perform model rollouts and compute MSE stats for cloth simulation
compute_multi_horizon_mse: use evaluate to compute mean squared error scalars at horizons 1, 10, 20, 50, 100, and 200 steps
extract_trajectory_operations: call evaluate to get trajectory ops including faces, mesh positions, ground truth, and predicted positions
rollout_model_trajectory: use _rollout to step a model forward through time and collect position predictions into a tensor array
mask_kinematic_nodes: use _rollout to skip position updates for kinematic nodes while updating normal nodes during rollout
